## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add label
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `Label.gx` | `ui/label/Label.gx` |
| `Label.fixtures.go` | `ui/label/Label.fixtures.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/label/Label.gx"
package label

props {
  For      string   = ""
  Class    string   = ""
  Children gx.Node
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil
}

<label for={p.For} class={gx.Cx("flex items-center gap-2 text-sm leading-none font-medium select-none", p.Class)} {...p.Attrs}>{p.Children}</label>
```

```go title="ui/label/Label.fixtures.go"
package label

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var LabelFixtures = gx.Fixtures[LabelProps]{
	"Plain": {For: "email", Children: gx.Text("Email")},
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

## Usage

```gx
<label.Label for="email">Email</label.Label>
<input id="email" name="email" type="email" />
```

## Examples

### Plain

<Example item="label" name="label-plain" label="Label: Plain">

```gx

```

</Example>

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Point `For` at the id of the control.
- Keep the label short.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not use placeholder text as the only label.
- Do not point `For` at an element that is not a form control.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| (none) | Clicking the label moves focus to its control. |
